title: Late-Name Holdback at Cut-Off (Group Room Blocks)
content:
At the cut-off release of a Group Room Blocks rooming-list block a late-name holdback is kept back from the release. It follows the block's pickup, counted as the room nights of the organiser's confirmed Group Block Rate reservations naming the block against the contracted room nights: when they are at least **70 percent** of the contracted room nights, the holdback is **5 percent** of the contracted room nights, rounded down; when they are at least **50 percent** but below 70 percent, the holdback is **1** room for every night of the block; below 50 percent there is none.

### Questions the rule answers

**Which reservations make up the pickup here?** The organiser's Room Reservations that name the block, are booked at the Group Block Rate and stand confirmed, counted by their nights.

**What is "every night of the block"?** Each night from the arrival date up to, but not including, the departure date.

**Is the 5 percent taken of the pickup or of the contract?** Of the contracted room nights, rounded down to a whole room night.

### Worked holdbacks (hypothetical block: 300 contracted room nights, 4 nights from arrival to departure)

| Nights of confirmed Group Block Rate reservations naming the block | Share of the contract | Holdback kept back |
|---|---|---|
| 210 | 70 percent | 15 (5 percent of 300) |
| 209 | 69.7 percent | 4 (1 room for each of 4 nights) |
| 150 | 50 percent | 4 |
| 149 | 49.7 percent | none |

On 290 contracted room nights with the share at 70 percent or more, 5 percent is 14.5 and the holdback is 14.
